questions.stemHtml: A 38-year-old patient with hypopigmented nodular lesions with anethesia over arm with ulnar nerve involvement underwent a biopsy and intradermal antigen test. Based on the image, which statement regarding the condition is most accurate?

options.label: A
options.text: Tuberculoid leprosy with a positive antigen test

options.label: B
options.text: Lepromatous leprosy with a positive antigen test

options.label: C
options.text: Erythema nodosum leprosum with a negative antigen test

options.label: D
options.text: Lepromatous leprosy with a negative antigen test
